answer: The set of devices an account uses is stable: one phone, one laptop, rarely more. The network tracks the device graph per account and challenges a session that introduces a brand-new device with no history, especially when the same new device appears across many accounts at once. One forge proves nothing on its own; the proof is in the whole pattern of behaviour. Between a lagoon and a haven lies the whole point: Sybils are cheap to make but expensive to prove.
